commitResults.messageTitle: Add typed task commands for Level 4
commitResults.messageBody: Parse todo, deadline, and event commands into typed task displays so users can distinguish task kinds and timing details. Extend Java and UI tests to protect the new interaction.
Introduce Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses so type-specific timing and display behavior are polymorphic while HABI keeps a single Task collection.
Validate descriptions, delimiters, task numbers, and unknown commands without changing task-list state. Keep the session usable after recoverable input errors.
Centralize recoverable validation failures at the command-loop boundary while preserving every user-visible response.
Remove tasks by validated one-based number from the ArrayList, report the remaining count, and preserve the list after invalid deletion requests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Represent task kinds with an enum
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize todo, deadline, and event display icons in TaskType so the closed set of task kinds is explicit and type-safe.
